title: New insights into enhancement of cadmium biosorption from industrial wastewater through Chlorella sorokiniana HMYA based thin-film
content:

Chlorella sorokiniana HMYA thin film is an eco-friendly, cost-effective biosorbent, achieving up to 100% Cd2+ removal from real wastewater, offering scalable, sustainable solutions for industrial biosorption.
